_source: Transcribed from SubMiner's src/core/services/subtitle-cue-parser.test.ts @ 35adf8299cb9 (github.com/ksyasuda/SubMiner, GPL-3.0). sub_index.py is a faithful port of that parser, so these are same-algorithm conformance vectors. Only the test DATA (inputs + expected [start,end,text]) is transcribed here — the GPL .ts source is NOT vendored into the Apache tree; test-only, not shipped in the wheel. `fn` picks parse_srt/parse_ass/parse_cues; `expect` is [start_s, end_s, text] per cue (text keeps literal \N and stripped tags, matching the port).
